name: beam-veda
description: Multi-tenant beam pipe stock management app (Workers + D1, no R2 needed)

scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute beam-app-db --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute beam-app-db --file=./migrations/0002_seed_root.sql
scripts.db:remote-migrate: wrangler d1 execute beam-app-db --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute beam-app-db --remote --file=./migrations/0002_seed_root.sql
